releases.name: Tivano 2.1.1
releases.body:
[Download Tivano (.dmg, Apple silicon)](https://github.com/elijah7x/tivano/releases/download/v2.1.1/Tivano-2.1.1.dmg)

Open the DMG and drag Tivano to Applications. The Source code archives below are for developers, not app installers.

If Tivano 1.0.2 or earlier reports HTTP 403 while checking updates, install this DMG manually once. Later checks use public static feeds and do not require a GitHub login.

## English

## Bug fixes

- DeepSeek Harness no longer turns desktop profiles off and warns in every chat each time the DeepSeek Harness app updates: Tivano checks each new version once and keeps loading the profile whenever it fits. Only a version that really changed what Tivano reads runs without the profile, with one notice for that version.

## 简体中文

## 问题修复

- DeepSeek Harness 应用每次更新后，不再在每个对话中关闭桌面配置并提示版本不一致：Tivano 会对每个新版本检测一次，兼容时照常加载桌面配置；只有确实改变了 Tivano 所依赖内部结构的版本才会不加载桌面配置，且该版本只提示一次。

## Thanks

- No outside contributors.
